title: DecryptionKey::agree_ecdh doc mismatches what ecdh_wrap_cek actually builds
description: The agree_ecdh doc says the implementor should 'hash Z concatenated with a counter and the SharedInfo structure (which encodes alg.key_wrap OID and ukm)'. But ecdh_wrap_cek on the encrypt side builds SharedInfo with entity_u_info: None (ukm is NOT included). An implementor who reads the doc and builds SharedInfo including the UKM will produce a different KEK than the encrypt side, causing silent decryption failure. The doc should either say 'ukm is NOT included in SharedInfo by this crate' or the code should be fixed.
